# Flare UpOFT <-> RH: DVN Config Fix (1 -> 4 DVNs)

**Chain:** Flare (Chain ID: 14)

**Executor:** Deployer EOA `0x0f0Db7CEDD49587D78d67175Ff59Ed7069A35874` (owner **and** LZ delegate on Flare — verified on-chain; NOT the multisig)

**OApp:** UpOFT `0xe030A89fd2b7f858c8aA47725679CA25D467dFD1`

**LZ Endpoint:** `0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c`


> **Why:** The RH pathway on Flare was configured with only 1 DVN (LZ Labs), while RH's
> receive config requires {LZ, Nethermind, Canary} — so Flare -> RH messages could never
> commit (Nethermind/Canary were never paid on send). This fix sets both directions to the
> same 4-DVN set used by the ETH/Base <-> RH pathways: **LZ Labs, Nethermind, Canary, Superform**.
>
> Until Superform's RH DVN is deployed (RH currently runs 3 DVNs), RH -> Flare delivery is
> gated on that 4th DVN — same posture as RH -> ETH/Base. Flare -> RH works immediately
> after this fix. When the Superform RH DVN ships, only RH's own configs need updating.
>
> ULN: 20 confirmations, 4 required DVNs (sorted ascending), no optional DVNs:
> - Superform:  `0x9b0f8cada2f412c17e6f848ebbd3cbdd09226a29`
> - Nethermind: `0x9bcd17a654bffaa6f8fea38d19661a7210e22196`
> - LZ Labs:    `0x9C061c9A4782294eeF65ef28Cb88233A987F4bdD`
> - Canary:     `0xd791948db16ab4373fa394b74c727ddb7fb02520`
>
> (Addresses per LayerZero metadata API for chain `flare`.)
